title: Venmo Integration FAQ
body:
Note: You cannot add a new payment method directly on the Discord mobile app.

What does this article cover? 

  • How do I Add Venmo as a Payment Method?
    • On Desktop/Web Browser
    • On Mobile Web Browser

How Do I Add Venmo as a Payment Method? 

The Venmo app is required in order to add your Venmo account as a payment method. If you do not currently have it installed on your mobile phone, then you'll be prompted to download the app before continuing.

On Desktop/Web Browser

After you download the app, you will need to head into your User Settings > Billing Tab > Add Payment Method and select Venmo to add it as a payment method to your Discord account.

When you select Venmo, a QR code will pop-up on your screen and you will be prompted to scan the code using your mobile device.

After you’ve scanned the QR code, you will be redirected in the mobile app where you will be asked to authorize the payment method. The QR code should disappear and you will see that your Venmo account has been authorized.

Upon completion, the name of your Venmo account will appear as the name for your payment method.

Once you’ve authorized your Venmo account, select Next. Here, you will enter your billing address information. This is still required in order to complete the process. 

After entering your billing address information, you’re now finished with adding Venmo as a payment method in Discord!

On Mobile Web Browser

As a reminder, you cannot add a new payment method directly on the Discord mobile app. These are steps for a mobile web browser.

Similar to the process on the desktop app, you will need to head into your User Settings > Billing Tab > Add Payment Method and select Venmo.

When you select Venmo, you will be asked to follow steps to complete your account connection. Go ahead and tap on Connect to Venmo.

You will then be redirected to the Venmo app where your Venmo account will be authorized as a payment method. 

When you return to the Discord app, you should see that your account has been authorized. The name of your Venmo account will be the name of your payment method.

Once you’ve authorized your Venmo account, select Next. Here you will enter your billing address information. This is still required in order to complete the process.

After entering your billing address information, you’re now finished with adding Venmo as a payment method in Discord!
